subject.title: [Feature]: GitHub Copilot provider cannot reach GitHub Enterprise data-residency (*.ghe.com) tenants

question: Should the bundled github-copilot provider accept allowlisted GitHub Enterprise data-residency tenant routing, including provider config/env domain selection and domain-scoped token cache behavior?
rationale: This is narrower than a new provider because OpenClaw already bundles github-copilot, but it changes OAuth/token destinations, setup UX, config/env surface, and credential cache boundaries.

options.title: Accept bounded bundled-provider routing
options.body: Review and harden the linked PR as the supported path for github-copilot to handle github.com plus single-label *.ghe.com tenant hosts.

options.title: Move GHE routing out of core
options.body: Reject bundled-provider tenant routing and require a separate plugin or ClawHub package for enterprise-specific behavior.

options.title: Define a generic tenant-host API first
options.body: Pause the linked PR until maintainers define a reusable provider-auth tenant-host contract instead of provider-specific config and SDK exports.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded bundled-provider routing
recommendation.body: Review and harden the linked PR as the supported path for github-copilot to handle github.com plus single-label *.ghe.com tenant hosts.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest current-main history signal on the inspected Copilot provider/auth files and the recent refactor that localized those helpers.
